manifest.name: dsh-external-session
manifest.description: DSH routed session persistence: persist selected projects' sessions natively inside the project repository (.dsh-sessions) so git clone/push syncs conversations across devices.

bundle.text:
# dsh-external-session bundle patch.
#
# This plugin REPLACES the default JSONL session-persistence backend with a
# routed one: sessions whose cwd falls under a configured external project are
# stored natively inside that project (<root>/<--cwd-->/<sessionId>/…), while
# every other workspace keeps using the internal root (default $DSH_HOME/sessions).
#
# The default row lives in the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` bundle layer; the profile
# patch layer is applied after every bundle layer, so disabling it here and
# inserting our provider is the one-and-only replacement point (single-provider
# Cordis Service semantics). Reversible: remove these lines to restore the stock
# backend.
- id: session-persistence-jsonl
  disabled: true

# The routed backend. Per-project routing config is user-specific and belongs in
# the PROFILE cordis.patch.yml (or a --patch overlay), not here — see README.zh.md
# "安装" for the exact external-entry shape.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-external-session
      name: dsh-external-session

readme.text:
Portable Git-backed external session persistence for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

Sessions created under configured project roots are stored in `.dsh-sessions/` using clone-path-independent relative directory keys. The plugin reads legacy absolute-path layouts and remaps them when a repository is cloned elsewhere.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XiaoYuOvO/dsh-external-session
```

After installation, configure the project root in the profile `cordis.patch.yml`; see [README.zh.md](README.zh.md) for configuration, migration behavior, safety rules, and tests.

```powershell
node test/run-tests.mjs
node test/web-routes.mjs
node test/fork-inherit.mjs
```
